name: Pydantic
covers: Rerail's own Pydantic rules, from the Pydantic v2 docs and migration guide, for correct models, validators and serialization.

rules.title: Pydantic practice: Pydantic 1 API that Pydantic 2 removed or ignores, in a project pinned to Pydantic 2
Pydantic practice: `model_dump()` handed to json.dumps, a JSONResponse or `json=` while the model has a datetime, UUID, Decimal or other field json cannot encode

caught.text:
import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.schemas import Event

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/events")
def create_event(event: Event) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(content=event.model_dump(), status_code=201)


async def notify(event: Event) -> None:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        await client.post("https://hooks.example.com/events", json=event.model_dump())

with.text:
from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel


class Event(BaseModel):
    name: str
    starts_at: datetime

passes.text:
import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.schemas import Event

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/events")
def create_event(event: Event) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(content=event.model_dump(mode="json"), status_code=201)


async def notify(event: Event) -> None:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        await client.post("https://hooks.example.com/events", json=event.model_dump(mode="json"))

with.text:
from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel


class Event(BaseModel):
    name: str
    starts_at: datetime

rules.title: Pydantic practice: a validator that can end without returning the value (or `self`)
Pydantic practice: field default computed once at import instead of a default_factory

caught.text:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Order(BaseModel):
    id: UUID = uuid4()
    created_at: datetime = Field(default=datetime.now(timezone.utc))

passes.text:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Order(BaseModel):
    id: UUID = Field(default_factory=uuid4)
    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))

rules.title: Pydantic practice: a before, wrap or plain validator that uses its raw input as one type without checking it
Pydantic practice: secret on a settings class typed str instead of SecretStr

caught.text:
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    SECRET_KEY: str
    SMTP_PASSWORD: str | None = None
    ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 60

passes.text:
from pydantic import SecretStr
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    SECRET_KEY: SecretStr
    SMTP_PASSWORD: SecretStr | None = None
    JWT_TOKEN_AUDIENCE: str = "api"
    ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 60
